concept: A bright making studio where an idea can become a painting, a small sculpture, or simply a joyful first mark.
floor: One broad continuous pale-aqua studio floor across the full top face, formed from only six oversized softly beveled resin slabs without paint splatters, grids, rugs, or separate paths.
main_structure: One broad open-front cream artist studio at the rear with a rounded coral-and-violet roof, one large blank canvas, and one oversized glowing spark ornament above the opening.
rear_props: one broad making table with one oversized palette, two large paint pots, and one chunky brush
two large warm studio lamps flanking the rear workspace
side_props: one chunky blank easel and one broad closed supply chest on the upper-left edge
one simple rounded clay sculpture on a broad low plinth and one oversized pencil cup on the upper-right edge

perimeter.material: one continuous smooth coral-and-aqua studio border with broad cream capstones
perimeter.emblems: four oversized simple spark, brush, and palette emblems

materials: a few broad aqua and muted-violet blocks

lighting: soft cheerful daylight with one broad creative-spark glow and two large warm studio lamp pools
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as quiet open pale-aqua studio floor
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature, person, portrait, or egg baked into the bitmap
center circle, platform, plaza, ring, rug, path, paint puddle, or indentation
bridges, clouds, artwork on the canvas, readable labels, text, watermark, external shadow
tiny brushes, paint flecks, ink splatters, pencil marks, loose paper, specks, or dense clutter
